study.question: Does aligning the auxiliary history scorer normalization population between training and evaluation improve auxiliary prediction and shared-context learning, preserving or improving click AUC beyond g0-r0028-dispatch_folded under the frozen protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observed source limitation: g0-r0028-dispatch_folded scores the auxiliary30 rows with native per-batch Dice moments during training, discards their running state, then shares primary Dice running moments at eval. The primary population contains uniform, feedback and duplicated rotated-support rows (70 normalization rows despite50 affine representatives); auxiliary training has only30 uniform/feedback rows. This is a verified code-path difference, not measured distribution divergence or its causal explanation. The incumbent improves click over both sources (0.6668445431 versus0.6606469405 and0.6601633627), but its cart/fav/buy AUCs0.7793168092/0.7874743031/0.7582542099 trail DIN0.8490697020/0.8648974929/0.8701822751; source ownership, compression and other architecture changes confound that historical comparison. Hypothesis: task-appropriate normalization populations can improve auxiliary generalization and the quality of auxiliary gradients into shared context. Compare two consistent population choices and their crossed mismatches. Training on the primary population can reuse detached primary strata; independent feedback running buffers permit evaluating the original feedback training population. Click improvement is uncertain and must be measured; auxiliary-only improvement is a separate outcome.

nearest_work.difference: Inherits DIN local activation and Dice batch training/moving-average inference semantics. Varies population ownership across task routes, not Dice equations or a new normalization operator. Paper does not establish local benefit or originality of this adaptation.

Retains exact native Dice: nonaffine BatchNorm1d, momentum0.01, eps1e-9 and learned alpha. Adds six nonlearned auxiliary running-state buffers, never a cloned trainable scorer. Fixed momentum makes the bridge independent of the different auxiliary num_batches_tracked history.

Direct ancestor and closest full local control; only auxiliary train population and eval running-state source change. Bridge collects unused auxiliary state but retains feedback30 training and primary-state inference. No training executed locally.

Earlier controls changed gradients through primary support moments and observed a click/auxiliary tradeoff. This study leaves primary moments and all support derivatives native, changing only detached auxiliary representations and their inference calibration.

inherited_components: All learned modules and initialization from g0-r0028-dispatch_folded, including embeddings, action-aware scorer, four towers and zero-initialized task adapters
Uniform click compression; feedback-partition auxiliary readout; masked target-match and ordinal summaries
Attached rotated support and folded50 affine/expanded70 native Dice primary training; pruned30 primary eval
Auxiliary scorer and item/action/target gradients blocked; context and auxiliary adapters/towers trainable; direct task-adapter execution
study.proposed_difference: A2x2 factorial over auxiliary_train_population={feedback,primary} and auxiliary_eval_population={primary,feedback}. Every model registers independent clones of the scorer running buffers after all inherited learned construction, with no RNG or extra parameters. Every training step performs the original detached auxiliary30 scorer pass using those independent buffers, updating feedback running state without touching primary state. In feedback-training cells use that pass; in primary-training cells use primary_strata.detach(), so no auxiliary path into primary scorer/item values is introduced. During eval primary-state cells reuse inherited primary_strata; feedback-state cells score the same30 compressed values using the same detached scorer parameters and auxiliary running buffers. All four task heads and residual detail paths remain unchanged. Eval-only factor must not affect a single training operation. This studies representation normalization/calibration, not a new architecture or verified novelty. Added running state is192 float values and2 integer counters (~784 bytes for native FP32/int64), host verifies. Expected learned parameters remain32129765 total/336549 dense.
predictions: At a matched state, feedback-training/primary-eval bridge reproduces the ancestor probabilities, all learned gradients and original running buffers within host-declared FP32/bf16 tolerances; extra auxiliary buffers alone may differ.

Within each training-population pair, eval-population choice has identical training outputs, losses, gradients, original/auxiliary running buffers and learned state under the frozen deterministic seed. Click evaluation predictions are identical within that pair because only auxiliary evaluation routing differs.

If inference population mismatch is consequential, feedback_train_feedback_eval improves auxiliary AUC and/or Logloss versus feedback_train_primary_eval at the same trained state while click is unchanged. Reverse the eval comparison in primary-training cells: primary_train_primary_eval should beat primary_train_feedback_eval on auxiliary quality if alignment rather than one universally preferable set of moments explains the effect.

If primary-population auxiliary training improves shared context learning, aux_primary_primary exceeds bridge click AUC0.6668445431089562 (and both frozen source bests) with32129765 learned parameters; a >=0.0001 single-seed improvement is a predeclared follow-up trigger, not significance or proof.

Feedback eval requires a second30-row scorer pass and may increase inference latency. Training work is matched by collecting feedback moments in every cell. Report actual costs, all four AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, and the fixed history slices with counts and negatives=samples-positives.
falsifiers: Failure of bridge parity, gradients/source ownership, running-buffer isolation, parameter/initialization parity, masking, checkpoint round-trip or finite FP32/bf16 forward/backward invalidates interpretation; keep failed cost and repair before comparison.

If matching inference moments does not improve auxiliary quality over the corresponding crossed mismatch, the tested population-alignment explanation lacks support. A gain from one eval buffer source in BOTH training arms supports a preference for that population, not alignment.

If primary-population training fails to improve click over the bridge, useful shared-context transfer is unsupported for this implementation even if auxiliary metrics improve. Click below the incumbent rules out selecting this arm as the primary-score improvement.

If own-state feedback evaluation improves auxiliary metrics but leaves click unchanged as predicted, this is an inference-calibration finding, not new click modeling capacity or evidence that auxiliary gradients caused prior click gains.

If gains disappear on authorized paired repetitions or cannot justify added measured inference cost, retain a preliminary/null or dominated result; never reclassify an implementation failure as mechanism refutation.
alternative_explanations: The historical auxiliary deficit may come from intentionally blocked item/scorer gradients, different readout, compression, rare labels, limited one-pass optimization or representation capacity; it does not by itself diagnose normalization.
Primary-stat sharing may beneficially regularize auxiliary tasks; matching moments is not guaranteed to help. Running-state lag during evolving scorer weights can persist even when populations match.

Primary training activation includes live normalization support while eval prunes support after moments are frozen; a residual ordinary train/inference gap remains. The experiment does not remove this inherited gap.

Changing auxiliary train representations changes auxiliary towers/adapters and context updates together; improved click does not isolate a particular context-gradient mechanism without a later context-gradient blocking contrast.

BF16 arithmetic, shared scorer weight evolution, seed variation and validation selection across many historical trials can explain small differences. Same-seed eval pairs are diagnostic contrasts, not independent repetitions.

Feedback running state is measured along the current primary-parameter trajectory. A single-seed result cannot establish general benefit, production timing validity, novelty, or transfer to differently attributed conversion labels.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Frozen protocol estimated_unit_seconds481.3475877419114, trial_cap_seconds1203.3689693547785; latest direct folded353.4166692 seconds(train320.2176719, inference26.9911793). remaining_seconds121230.54768586159 at context resolution, decreases with all preparation. Four full-data from-scratch variants estimated1500-2200 seconds total; conservatively reserve4*1203.3689693547785=4813.476 seconds including failures; host ledger is authoritative.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Preserve>=12000 seconds beyond this suite for host diagnostics, source-gradient and population-isolation gates, meaningful repairs and paired repeats of a consequential direction. No local calibration/training/installations. Any host diagnostics, repeated jobs or failed attempts consume the same wall budget. No duplicate eval-pair training is counted as independent replication.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Preserve>=12000 seconds for final authorized paired assessment of selected candidate, both frozen source bests and closest controls. This proposal requests validation only and neither accesses nor freezes a held-out suite. Select and hash all code/config/checkpoints, controls, seeds and commands before any future withheld request; closed outcomes must remain outside open memory.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not start if actual remaining ledger cannot cover the next complete admissible unit plus reserves; respect the immutable deadline and per-trial cap. Stop on user stop or integrity loss. Bridge/gate failure requires diagnosis and retains all cost; do not auto-repeat an unknown execution. No extra variants beyond these four without a new prospective record. Prefer the frozen incumbent if no useful click improvement is observed; auxiliary-only utility is reported separately.
